name: hollerback
description: Ask the other Claude Code session a question and get an answer back, without copy-pasting between terminals.

BROKER_URL.title: Broker URL
BROKER_URL.description: Where the hollerback broker is running.

AGENT_NAME.title: Override this session's id (advanced, usually leave blank)
AGENT_NAME.description: Leave blank. Sessions identify themselves as <host>:<project-dir> automatically. Setting this pins ONE id for every workspace on this machine, so they would all share an inbox.
